pkgmetadata.longdescription:
golangci-lint runs many Go linters in parallel, deduplicates and normalizes their output, and integrates with editors and CI.
This ebuild mirrors the current ::gentoo dev-go/golangci-lint packaging (go-module.eclass source build using the gentoo-golang-dist vendor tarball), with ~arm64 added to KEYWORDS since the official tree only keywords ~amd64.
